يلتوين (form VIII)
# يَلْتَوِينَ (yaltawīna) /jal.ta.wiː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
# يُلْتَوَيْنَ (yultawayna) /jul.ta.waj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
